M1.reason: The reproduction is a plain rectangular box. Silhouette overlap is 0.575 front/back, 0.536 left/right and 0.569 top/below, all well under 0.80. It has no legs, so the gap between the four legs seen in front, back and side views is filled solid. The side views lose the hunched back with its dorsal spines and the rounded head. From above, the tapered teardrop body has become a rectangle.

M2.reason: Its bounding size matches the original exactly: 49.3 x 33.5 x 44.7 on both, with offShare 0 on every axis.

M3.reason: None of the original's parts are there. It has no four legs with hooves, no front face disc with its cluster of dark eye-pods, no dorsal spines or ridges, no underside mouth and no tail. It is one box.

M4.reason: Measured mean deltaE is 33.4, more than twice the line of 15, and no view comes in under 30. The original's yellow-green hide, cyan and brown stripes, pale belly and dark red-black face disc are all replaced by a uniform grey stone-like texture.

M5.reason: The original's surface detail is all missing: the cyan and brown banding along the back, the green vein lines on the belly, the eye-pod cluster and its fleshy rim, the underside mouth and the skin folds on the legs. The only detail is a grey mottle with light edges, which the original does not have.

M6.reason: At game size a player would see a grey crate where a yellow, striped, four-legged creature should be. Nobody would take it for the original.

M7.reason: The box sits upright on the ground plane and fills the original's bounds, so it is placed right. But it has no front to face, so the original's facing (face disc forward) is not reproduced.

M8.reason: checkErrors is empty. It has 12 triangles, far below twice the original's 308. The pictures show a closed box resting on the ground: nothing open, inside out or floating.

C1.reason: The motion sheet shows the original's run across eight frames, with legs reaching, bending and pushing off. The reproduction shows one static box in a single frame. It has no legs or body parts to move, so the run is not reproduced at all.
